items.title: Magic Skies Anime
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Take your mining and crafting to the skies in this Japanese inspired skyblock world of magical floating islands! Travel around, search for loot, investigate the pagodas! Immerse yourself and chill.

-Comfy terrain and relaxing environment.
-Islands with plenty of loot.
-Enjoy exploring on your own or with friends!

items.title: Skyland Desert Skulls
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Use an intricate teleport system & fight your way through Skyland! Adventurers beware, some islands might be more dangerous than others. Choose wisely!

+ Travel to different unique floating islands with an advanced teleport system.
+ Loot galore! Exploring will be worth your time.
+ Different difficulty on every island!

items.title: Noob vs Pro Ultimate Base
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Ease your mind as your base is totally secured! High-tech security measures under your control to keep your base safe from any unwanted visitors!

- Working security cameras!
- Working laser gates!
- Working lift!
- Huge base to explore!

And much more!

items.title: Masked Teens
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
Put on your masks and go unnoticed with these outfits! Anonymity is yours!

+ 12 skins

items.title: Pets Bikers
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Are these biker pets? Whoa, they seem funny and friendly. How about some fluffy skins to play as? They're cute and extreme! This skin pack introduces you to the fantasy that is biker pets and what they look like. Join the game and enjoy!

+ 2 free skins
+ By In Mine

items.title: Zombie Apocalypse 2
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Are you ready to survive in a zombie apocalypse? Will you play as a survivor or as a zombie? Will you hunt down other players? The game awaits, choose your skin and join the survival!

+ Zombie
+ Apocalypse
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Urban Fashion Anime
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Are you ready to join the game as a fashionable anime teen? This skin pack brings you anime and urban-styled looks. Select the perfect fit for your personality and stun your friends with new skin!

+ Fashion
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Mob Illusions
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Trick your friends with these fun mob illusion skins! These skins are perfect for your mob adventures!

items.title: PrestonPlayz Fire Dragons
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
Watch out for the fierce and fiery dragons! Avoid the wrath of Preston’s dragons by joining the pack! Colorful dragons such as red, orange, yellow, and purple.

- 1 free Preston skin
- 14 total skins

By PrestonPlayz & CinemaCraft

items.title: PrestonPlayz Prison Roleplay
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
Watch out, noob1234 is on a jailing spree, and you’ve been locked up in Preston’s prison! Do you choose to be a guard or prisoner? Pick today!

- 1 free Preston skin
- 19 total skins
- Perfect for prison roleplay

By PrestonPlayz & CinemaCraft

items.title: BriannaPlayz Nurse Teens
items.creator: FireGames
items.description:
Join Brianna, Preston, and the crew for action! Suit up in any of these nurse, doctor, or scrub skins. Perfect for hospital roleplay!

- 2 free Brianna and Preston skins
- 12 total skins

By BriannaPlayz & CinemaCraft

items.title: RANDOM SKYBLOCK
items.creator: Doctor Benx
items.description:
Skyblock, but every 60s a completely new island is randomly generated! This is the concept of RANDOM SKYBLOCK. Experience skyblock in a whole new way, thanks to new game mechanics and tactics!

-33'386'248 island combinations
-12'977'875 diamond chest variations

-Diamond chest with random items
-New tactics + game mechanics
-Dungeon island

-By oectway + Benx

items.title: Street Teens
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These teens have the latest in street fashion and are ready to hit the skatepark! 

- 8 human skins!
- With hoodies, branded sneakers, headsets, and beanies! Find your own style with 'Street Teens'!

items.title: Cat Ears
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These teens have found the perfect accessory for their awesome outfits... brand new cat ears! With a mixture between cool and cute, you'll stand out from any crowd!

- 8 cat ear skins!
- Different outfit designs so you can pick the skin that suits your style best!

items.title: Elves
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Deep in the forest biome, these magical elves live in peace and protect nature! From fancy high-fantasy outfits to crude druid-like designs, there's a perfect elf for you!

- 8 elf skins!
- Many different outfit designs so you can pick the skin that suits you best!

items.title: ONE BLOCK PLANETS
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
ONE BLOCK PLANETS! is an amazing and exciting challenge! Break the block below you and it will get replaced by another one. Gather enough resources to reach and explore the planets and collect all the different treasures! One block adds a little spice to Skyblock!

Includes:

- One block in the overworld
- 1 Skin
- Planets
- Hidden treasures
- By KA Studios

items.title: ELEMENTAL TEENS
items.creator: CanadaWebDeveloper
items.description:
Elemental Teens brings your personality, character, and knowledge to Minecraft, pick your power and be ready for everything! Made for true gamers with strong influence.

15 HD skins (128px) including:

- 1 free exclusive skin by: Dannny0117
- 14 styles representing the elemental powers with and without signs


Created and Published by: Dannny0117 + Canada Web Developer.

items.title: Meme Dogs
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
Featuring some of your favorite meme dogs and some brand new classics! When you have Baby Doge and Walter, you'll want to sit, stay, and speak all about them to all of your friends! Bow WOW!

+ Includes 6 boomificent skins!

items.title: Rocket Mobs
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
The mobs go to the next level, and start conquering space!
Play as one of them and explore deep space aboard a customized rocket!

- 10 unique rocket mobs skins!
- Perfect to attract all eyes on you!
- By Pixelusion

items.title: Enderman Dragon Knights 2
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
The Enderman have returned once again to the dark and powerful side of the End to defend all portals! Break out with these new epic knight based skins and continue ruling the end in your survival world! Slay or be slain by the ender dragon!

- 10 dragon rider Enderman themed skins!
- Dragon king skin included!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Diamond Creeper Cave
items.creator: VoxelBlocks
items.description:
Look at all the diamonds in this cave! Look at that big diamond block in the center of the cave! We must mine it! Bring your enchanted diamond sword and fight your way to the big diamond block!

+ Diamond creepers
+ 2 Skins

items.title: Flowers
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Be stunning and vibrant as you show off your style! Perfect for any time of year, look cute with colorful flowers!

+ 12 skins to choose from!

items.title: Arts and Crafts
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Are you crafty? Enjoy painting, drawing, or sculpting? This skin pack is perfect for you!

+ 12 skins to choose from!

items.title: Creeper Mountain
items.creator: VoxelBlocks
items.description:
Diamonds, diamonds are everywhere! The creepers have invaded the creeper mountain. Kill them to get awesome loot!

+ Diamond Creepers
+ Lucky loot drops
+ 1 skin
